body:
QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. CHECK-047 complete, behind rpt-ref-e23aa05d834f8e89bb2c. Owner code neither read nor run.

Everything the order names re-derives: 72/72 arithmetic rows, and 43/44 rows of an independent CalculiX model (own mesh, 4 mm at the dimple).

Criterion: 95.4608 kPa is ISA 500 m; SF 1.05 = 100.2339.

Perfect sphere: membrane statics put first yield at 80.95/95.24/109.52 kPa, inside all three brackets. Own FE gives 80.977/95.283/109.594 (card 80.974/95.280/109.590); endpoints within 0.003 kPa.

345 MPa brackets: same pass/fail at every tested pair. SF 1: 1.209/1.227 mm carry 344.646/345.358 MPa (card 344.597/345.309). SF 1.05: 344.619/345.380 (card 344.585/345.345). Estimates 1.2179/0.7469 mm (card 1.2192/0.7478). Own 345 MPa runs yield where the card's do; L332, W402 and cure-debit pairs reproduce.

Core law: own exact minimisation puts ellipticity loss at 0.0877 MPa shear for the inherited law (CHECK-029: 0.088) and 2.65 MPa for the regularized one. At the governing state: +0.498 MPa regularized, -0.005444 inherited (card -0.005455). Regularization from 0.01 to 10 MPa moves the answer at most 0.004 mm.

Endpoint division: own endpoints 105.0765/104.9167 kPa (card 105.0759/104.9204), same 0.521-0.539 mm; transfer factors match CHECK-029.

One mismatch: the 11.8 mm face-yield estimate, 61.910 against 63.596 kPa (coarse sweep mesh; diagnostic only). Two NFI: unsourced E = 290 GPa (298.7 GPa adds 0.015 mm); unstated sweep mesh.
